summary: The letter from an advocacy group urges the FCC to reject any proposal to terminate or limit the E‑Rate program, arguing that such action would severely cut school and library budgets, leave vulnerable communities without reliable internet, and undermine the ability of libraries to serve their patrons. Libraries support continued E‑Rate funding to maintain affordable, reliable internet for schools and libraries.
